name: Hatsukoi Zensen.
source:
This is the fandisk for I.D.’s debut title Hatsukoi Yohou., containing after stories for the main heroines, as well as another stories for the subcharacters Haruhi, Kokoa, Megumi and Tatsumi, along with new heroine Miyuri. 

[from [url=http://eroyume.com/2012/07/07/hatsukoi-zensen/]Eroyume[/url]]
translation:
I.D.首部作品《初恋预报。》的Fan Disc，收录主要女主角的后日谈，以及配角植村春雏、桃屋心爱、末长惠与水泽巽的另一段故事，此外还有新女主角西莲寺美百合登场。

[译自 [url=http://eroyume.com/2012/07/07/hatsukoi-zensen/]Eroyume[/url]]
